title: Cyber Defenders Unit 3 · Private means private (3-5)

items.q: Which of these is fine to share in a game chat?
choices: Where you live
A favorite animal
Your school name
Your birthday

items.q: A card shows a photo of a child wearing a school uniform. Which tray should Pim choose?
choices: The Share tray, because the photo is cheerful
The Share tray, if the child in it is smiling
Either tray, because one photo says very little
The Keep Private tray, because it can point to the child's school

items.q: Sam shares his first name, his school, and the street he lives on. Each fact seems small. Why is sharing all three a problem?
choices: Together they can point straight at Sam
Three facts are too long for anyone to read
Games never allow groups of three facts
Only teachers may ever know three facts

items.q: Which of these actions leaves an online footprint?
choices: Thinking about a game at home
Posting a photo for others to see
Watching snow fall outside
Drawing on paper and keeping it in a drawer

items.q: Why does an online footprint last longer than a footprint in snow?
choices: Snow footprints are harder to see
Screens are brighter than snow
Online posts stay, and screenshots can copy them
Only owls can follow an online trail

items.q: Mina posts a silly photo that feels fine today. Why might it read differently in a year?
choices: Mina may feel differently later, and others may have copied it
Photos slowly change their colors over time
A year turns every photo into a secret
New posts erase all the older posts

items.q: You want to post a photo of your friend at the park. Whose yes do you need first?
choices: Nobody's, because you took the photo
Your friend's yes, because the photo shows them
The park's yes, because it happened there
Any classmate's yes will do

items.q: What does a credit line do?
choices: It makes the work yours
It hides who made the work
It says who made the work, so makers can be found
It turns any work into public domain work

items.q: A friend posts a photo of you that you do not like. What is the best first move?
choices: Ask your friend to take it down
Post an unkind photo of them back
Never speak to your friend again
Share the photo with even more people
